items.title: Prediction market regulation roundup finds 21 states in disputes and three Supreme Court petitions pending, WSN reports

items.title: Prediction markets sway voters and more than 80 percent favor stricter rules, Brennan Center study finds, Casino.org reports
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets sway voters and more than 80 percent favor stricter rules, Brennan Center study finds, Casino.org reports** — Casino.org reported a Brennan Center for Justice study found a market-favored candidate gains a 10 to 20 percentage point boost in perceived victory regardless of polling, while low market odds reduce perceived viability by 11 to 19 points. items.content_text: - **Canada draws a narrow lane for prediction markets under CIRO rules, BitcoinCasinos reports** — Under joint guidance from CIRO and the Canadian Securities Administrators issued August 27, authorized Canadian dealers may offer event contracts tied only to economic forecasts, environmental indicators and financial markets with a minimum 30-day maturity, while contracts on elections and other political outcomes remain prohibited. items.title: CFTC asks court to dismiss CME lawsuit over Kalshi Bitcoin perpetual approval, CryptoCompass reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC asks court to dismiss CME lawsuit over Kalshi Bitcoin perpetual approval, CryptoCompass reports** — CryptoCompass reported the CFTC asked Judge Colleen Kollar-Kotelly on October 16 to dismiss CME's June 18 lawsuit over the approval of Kalshi's Bitcoin perpetual, arguing CME showed no harm as its own crypto futures volume rose from about 2.66 million contracts in May to 3.28 million in September. CME, Nasdaq and Cboe also objected to the SEC on October 14 over Kalshi's planned perpetual security futures tied to individual stocks. ([CryptoCompass](https://cryptocompass.com/articles/cme-s-fight-with-kalshi-spreads-to-oil-as-phantom-opens-a-new-door-for-the-prediction-market))
